parts.text: {"section_id":"sec12","title":"Partnership Overview","phase":"Close","summary":"A structured operating model and governance framework designed to transition Northstar Retail Group from legacy maintenance to a high-velocity modernization engine.","narrative":["The partnership model translates the technical roadmap into an execution rhythm, ensuring that modernization waves are governed by a strict design authority to prevent architectural drift. By aligning delivery centers in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Guadalajara, the model optimizes for both 24/7 engineering velocity and North American business alignment.","Governance is anchored by a weekly Transformation Design Authority and a monthly Architecture Review Board, providing the necessary oversight for complex dependencies across customer identity, pricing, and supply-chain rewrites. This cadence ensures that platform engineering capacity is managed as a shared resource, preventing parallel peak demand from stalling critical path items.","The execution model is designed for a phased shift in labor distribution, moving from a high-onshore presence to a target 55% offshore mix by year 3. This transition is not merely a cost-saving measure but a strategic rebalancing that allows onshore leadership to focus on product ownership and architecture while the engineering factory scales in India."],"kpi_cards":[{"label":"Delivery Centers","value":"3","subtitle":"Global operating footprint","fact_key":"delivery_center_count"}],"tables":[],"cards":[{"widget":"partnership-overview","title":"Governance Cadence","detail":"Weekly Transformation Design Authority and monthly Architecture Review Board meetings to manage modernization waves."},{"widget":"partnership-overview","title":"Target Delivery Mix","detail":"Strategic shift to 35% onshore, 10% nearshore, and 55% offshore by Year 3."}],"chart":null,"matrix":null,"timeline":[],"delivery_cards":[],"callouts":["Holiday code freeze applies from mid-November through early January for customer-facing platforms to ensure stability during peak retail season.","Target delivery-mix shift to 55% offshore is achieved by year 3, with architecture and product ownership remaining onshore-led.","Architecture review board meets monthly and transformation design authority meets weekly during active modernization waves.","Wave 1 prioritizes customer identity, pricing, returns, and observability foundations before major order and supply-chain rewrites."],"fact_refs":["delivery_center_count"],"evidence_refs":[],"required_widgets":["partnership-overview"]}
